summary:
Three bench recall fixes applied and verified. Commit: 4994457.

CHANGE 1 — ingest.py date in body:
  BEFORE: summary = part_text (date was title-only, answerer never read it)
  AFTER:  summary = f"Session date: {date}\n{part_text}"

CHANGE 2 — probe_runner.py full-text context:
  BEFORE: summary = "\n".join(lines)[:_SUMMARY_BUDGET]  (2000-char clip before ingest)
  AFTER:  summary = "\n".join(lines)  (no clip; ingest chunker already bounds at 6000)

CHANGE 3 — arms.py DAG+RAG inject:
  BEFORE: context_blocks = [DAG-kept dep summaries only]; sub-0.55 probes get empty context
  AFTER:  context_blocks = [DAG deps tagged [DAG]] + [RAG-fill hits tagged [RAG], deduped]

VERIFY (3/3 probes, foreground, <2 min):
  P1 LoCoMo temporal "When did Caroline go to LGBTQ support group?" (gold: 7 May 2023):
    BEFORE body[0]: '[D1:1] Caroline: Hey Mel! Good to see you!...' (no date)
    AFTER  body[0]: 'Session date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023' => PASS

  P2 LoCoMo temporal "When did Melanie paint a sunrise?" (gold: 2022):
    BEFORE body[0]: '[D1:1] Caroline: Hey Mel!...' (no date)
    AFTER  body[0]: 'Session date: 1:56 pm on 8 May, 2023' => PASS

  P3 LME-S "What degree did I graduate with?" (gold: Business Administration):
    BEFORE: DAG kept 0 keys (sub-0.55 threshold); answerer sees nothing
    AFTER:  RAG fill added 5 keys; needle note-mqikekrbwj1 surfaced; body contains 'business administration' => PASS

Honesty bar: gold never enters retrieve/keep/answer paths.

subject: Bench recall fixes: date-in-note-body + full-text answer context + inject DAG+RAG into the answer agent
description:
From the real pilot (#31) + KB inspection. The KB notes are RAW chunked session text (facts present), so the low scores are NOT summary-loss; they're (1) date only in the note title not the body the answerer reads, and (2) the DAG keep missing the needle at scale. Three changes:

(1) DATE IN BODY: in the ingester (bench/agent-memory/ingest.py ConversationIngester.ingest), prepend "Session date: <date>\n" to each note's BODY/summary (the field returned in dependencySummaries / search results), so the answerer can resolve relative times ("yesterday" → absolute). Date is currently only in the note title.

(2) FULL-TEXT ANSWER CONTEXT: ensure the answer context uses the full retrieved note text, not a _SUMMARY_BUDGET clip (notes are already chunked into parts at ingest, so clipping the answer context drops facts). Raise/remove the clip on the answer path.

(3) INJECT DAG + RAG (user directive): in the our-way answer path (arms.run_retrieve_and_answer used by probe_runner.run_our_way), after reading the DAG context_deps, ALSO run a RAG search over the session notes (client.search / search_knowledge with the question, note-only via the #30 _is_note_hit filter), take top-k, and INJECT BOTH the DAG context blocks AND the RAG note summaries into the answer prompt (dedupe by note key; tag DAG vs RAG for diagnostics). Keep the answerer tool-less/MCP-off — WE retrieve and inject, the answer agent does NOT call tools (consistent with the locked methodology). This is retrieve-then-answer with DAG+RAG, mirroring what production search_knowledge(task_key) returns (DAG tier + RAG fill).

VERIFY (SHORT, bounded foreground <10min — NO long background poll, that was the #31 hang): reuse the downloaded datasets at C:\\Users\\Imyu\\.zonoid-bench-data. Run ~5 real probes: (a) a LoCoMo temporal "when" probe → now date-grounded (not "Yesterday"); (b) an LME-S probe where DAG kept nothing → RAG inject surfaces the needle → answered. Report before/after per probe. Flat task off main. Self-drain quarantine, claim, commit. Honesty bar: gold never in retrieve/keep/answer.
